resources.string: While the alarm rings: pressing the power button turns the screen straight back on, the volume buttons do nothing, and if the phone is restarted the alarm rings again. Phone calls and emergency calls always work. \"Save & test\" never uses strict mode.
To also close the power-off menu and bring the alarm back if you leave it, turn on Anki Alarm in Accessibility settings.
If the switch there is greyed out: Settings → Apps → Anki Alarm → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Power-off menu and leave protection is on.

Used by Anki Alarm\'s strict mode, only while an alarm is ringing: closes the power-off menu and brings the alarm back if you leave it. It does nothing at other times and doesn\'t read what\'s on your screen.
